definition: The complete range of skills, techniques, or devices used in a particular field or occupation.
meaningKr: 레퍼토리, 연주 목록, (한 사람이 할 수 있는) 모든 것
exampleEn: The musician expanded her repertoire by incorporating traditional folk melodies into her contemporary jazz compositions.
exampleKr: 그 음악가는 현대 재즈 작곡에 전통 민요 선율을 통합함으로써 그녀의 레퍼토리를 확장했다.

definition: To acquire or secure something through effort, request, or a formal process.
exampleEn: Researchers must obtain written permission from the ethics committee before proceeding with any human subject experiments.
exampleKr: 연구자들은 인간 피험자 실험을 진행하기 전에 윤리 위원회로부터 서면 허가를 얻어야 한다.

definition: The way in which something is shared out among a group or spread over an area.
exampleEn: The study analyzes the geographical distribution of rare plant species across the tropical rainforest ecosystem.
exampleKr: 이 연구는 열대 우림 생태계 전반에 걸친 희귀 식물 종의 지리적 분포를 분석한다.

definition: A numerical or other measurable factor forming one of a set that defines a system.
exampleEn: The software allows users to adjust various parameters to simulate different environmental conditions in the model.
exampleKr: 이 소프트웨어는 사용자가 모델 내에서 다양한 환경 조건을 시뮬레이션하기 위해 매개변수를 조정할 수 있게 해준다.

definition: A particular part or feature of something that is being considered or analyzed.
exampleEn: The psychological aspect of recovery is just as important as the physical treatment for long-term health.
exampleKr: 회복의 심리적 측면은 장기적인 건강을 위한 물리적 치료만큼이나 중요하다.

definition: Characterized by constant change, activity, or progress within a system or process.
exampleEn: The market for renewable energy is highly dynamic, with new technological breakthroughs occurring almost every year.
exampleKr: 재생 에너지 시장은 거의 매년 새로운 기술적 돌파구가 나타나면서 매우 역동적이다.

definition: The powerful effect that something has on a situation, person, or environment.
exampleEn: The introduction of invasive species can have a devastating impact on the native biodiversity of an island.
exampleKr: 외래종의 도입은 섬의 자생적 생물 다양성에 파괴적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다.

definition: A specified sphere of activity or knowledge in which someone or something operates.
exampleEn: In the domain of theoretical physics, the laws of gravity are still being rigorously tested and debated.
exampleKr: 이론 물리학 영역에서 중력 법칙은 여전히 엄격하게 테스트되고 논의되고 있다.

definition: To prepare and issue a book, journal, or piece of information for public distribution.
exampleEn: The university press plans to publish the findings of the decade-long sociological study later this fall.
exampleKr: 대학 출판부는 올가을 말에 10년에 걸친 사회학 연구 결과를 발표할 계획이다.

definition: To be a sign of something or to indicate a specific meaning or reference.
exampleEn: In mathematical equations, the symbol 'x' is often used to denote an unknown variable or value.
exampleKr: 수학 방정식에서 기호 'x'는 종종 알 수 없는 변수나 값을 나타내는 데 사용된다.

definition: The power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience.
exampleEn: The government granted the local council the authority to implement new traffic regulations in the city center.
exampleKr: 정부는 지방 의회에 도심 내 새로운 교통 규제를 시행할 권한을 부여했다.

definition: Relating to the meaning of words, phrases, or symbols in a particular language.
exampleEn: The computer program uses semantic analysis to understand the context and intent behind user search queries.
exampleKr: 그 컴퓨터 프로그램은 사용자 검색 쿼리 뒤에 숨겨진 문맥과 의도를 이해하기 위해 의미론적 분석을 사용한다.

definition: The standard or average level of quality or performance expected in a specific context.
exampleEn: The new employee's performance is already on a par with the most experienced members of the team.
exampleKr: 신입 사원의 성과는 이미 팀에서 가장 경험이 많은 팀원들과 동등한 수준이다.

definition: An atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of electrons.
exampleEn: Positive ions are formed when an atom loses one or more electrons during a chemical reaction.
exampleKr: 양이온은 화학 반응 동안 원자가 하나 이상의 전자를 잃을 때 형성된다.

definition: An environment or material in which something develops, or a rectangular array of numbers.
exampleEn: The data was organized into a matrix to facilitate a multi-dimensional analysis of the experimental results.
exampleKr: 실험 결과의 다차원 분석을 용이하게 하기 위해 데이터가 행렬로 정리되었다.

definition: Arranged in or extending along a straight line, or progressing in a direct step-by-step manner.
exampleEn: The professor explained that history does not always follow a linear path of constant human progress.
exampleKr: 교수는 역사가 항상 인류의 지속적인 진보라는 선형적인 경로를 따르는 것은 아니라고 설명했다.

definition: Relating to the mental processes of perception, memory, judgment, and reasoning.
exampleEn: Sleep deprivation can significantly impair cognitive functions such as memory retention and logical problem-solving abilities.
exampleKr: 수면 부족은 기억력 유지 및 논리적 문제 해결 능력과 같은 인지 기능을 크게 저해할 수 있다.

definition: A diagram showing the relationship between variable quantities, typically measured along two axes.
exampleEn: The graph clearly illustrates the steady increase in global temperatures over the past several decades.
exampleKr: 이 그래프는 지난 수십 년 동안의 전 지구적 기온의 꾸준한 상승을 명확하게 보여준다.

definition: A mutual relationship or connection between two or more things or variables.
exampleEn: The study found a strong correlation between high levels of education and overall life expectancy.
exampleKr: 그 연구는 높은 교육 수준과 전반적인 기대 수명 사이에 강한 상관관계가 있음을 발견했다.

definition: Relating to language or the scientific study of language and its structure.
exampleEn: Students explored the linguistic diversity of the region, focusing on the unique dialects spoken in remote villages.
exampleKr: 학생들은 외딴 마을에서 사용되는 독특한 방언에 초점을 맞추어 그 지역의 언어적 다양성을 탐구했다.

definition: A chemical substance that neutralizes alkalis and has a pH of less than seven.
exampleEn: The laboratory experiment demonstrated how the acid reacts with metal to produce hydrogen gas and salt.
exampleKr: 실험실 실험은 산이 금속과 반응하여 수소 가스와 염을 생성하는 과정을 보여주었다.

definition: To succeed in persuading or leading someone to do something, or to cause something to happen.
exampleEn: Certain chemicals in the environment can induce mutations in the DNA of exposed organisms over time.
exampleKr: 환경 속의 특정 화학 물질은 시간이 지남에 따라 노출된 생물체의 DNA에 돌연변이를 유발할 수 있다.

definition: The speed of something in a given direction, often used in physics calculations.
exampleEn: The researchers measured the initial velocity of the projectile to calculate its final landing point accurately.
exampleKr: 연구자들은 발사체의 최종 낙하지점을 정확하게 계산하기 위해 그것의 초기 속도를 측정했다.

definition: A period of time between two events or a space between two objects.
exampleEn: The sensors were programmed to collect data at regular intervals of ten minutes throughout the day.
exampleKr: 센서들은 하루 종일 10분이라는 일정한 간격으로 데이터를 수집하도록 프로그래밍되었다.

definition: Written or spoken communication or debate on a particular subject or topic.
exampleEn: The academic discourse surrounding climate change has shifted from skepticism to urgent calls for global policy reform.
exampleKr: 기후 변화를 둘러싼 학술적 담론은 회의론에서 글로벌 정책 개혁을 위한 긴급한 요구로 바뀌었다.

definition: Having limits or bounds; not infinite in size, amount, or duration.
exampleEn: Because natural resources are finite, it is crucial to develop sustainable methods for energy production and consumption.
exampleKr: 천연자원은 유한하기 때문에, 에너지 생산과 소비를 위한 지속 가능한 방법을 개발하는 것이 매우 중요하다.

definition: A thing or event that evokes a specific functional reaction in an organ or tissue.
exampleEn: The nervous system responds to an external stimulus by sending electrical signals to the brain for processing.
exampleKr: 신경계는 처리를 위해 뇌로 전기 신호를 보냄으로써 외부 자극에 반응한다.

definition: A quantity having direction as well as magnitude, especially determining the position of one point relative to another.
exampleEn: In physics, force is considered a vector because it has both a specific strength and a direction.
exampleKr: 물리학에서 힘은 특정한 세기와 방향을 모두 가지고 있기 때문에 벡터로 간주된다.

definition: A stable subatomic particle with a charge of negative electricity, found in all atoms.
exampleEn: The flow of electrons through a conductive material is what creates an electric current in a circuit.
exampleKr: 전도성 물질을 통한 전자의 흐름이 회로에서 전류를 생성하는 것이다.

definition: An organ or cell able to respond to light, heat, or other external stimulus and transmit a signal.
exampleEn: The medicine works by binding to specific receptors on the surface of cells to block pain signals.
exampleKr: 그 약은 통증 신호를 차단하기 위해 세포 표면의 특정 수용체에 결합함으로써 작용한다.

definition: A general proposition not self-evident but proved by a chain of reasoning; a truth established by means of accepted truths.
exampleEn: The Pythagorean theorem describes the relationship between the three sides of a right-angled triangle in Euclidean geometry.
exampleKr: 피타고라스의 정리는 유클리드 기하학에서 직각 삼각형의 세 변 사이의 관계를 설명한다.

definition: A process or set of rules to be followed in calculations or other problem-solving operations, especially by a computer.
exampleEn: The search engine uses a complex algorithm to rank websites based on relevance and user engagement metrics.
exampleKr: 그 검색 엔진은 관련성과 사용자 참여 지표를 바탕으로 웹사이트 순위를 매기기 위해 복잡한 알고리즘을 사용한다.

definition: A substance that has no fixed shape and yields easily to external pressure; a gas or a liquid.
exampleEn: Engineers must understand fluid dynamics to design aircraft that can move efficiently through the air.
exampleKr: 엔지니어들은 공기 중을 효율적으로 이동할 수 있는 항공기를 설계하기 위해 유체 역학을 이해해야 한다.

definition: Relating to the process of growing, progressing, or maturing over a period of time.
exampleEn: The psychologist specialized in developmental stages, focusing on how children acquire language during their early years.
exampleKr: 그 심리학자는 아이들이 유아기 동안 어떻게 언어를 습득하는지에 초점을 맞추어 발달 단계에 특화했다.

definition: Destined or certain to happen, or restricted by a particular boundary or limit.
exampleEn: Without significant intervention, the global temperature is bound to rise further due to the greenhouse effect.
exampleKr: 중대한 개입이 없다면, 지구 기온은 온실 효과로 인해 더 상승할 수밖에 없다.

definition: Relating to or consisting of molecules, which are the smallest units of chemical compounds.
exampleEn: Advances in molecular biology have allowed scientists to map the entire human genome with incredible precision.
exampleKr: 분자 생물학의 발전으로 과학자들은 놀라운 정밀도로 전체 인간 게놈 지도를 작성할 수 있게 되었다.

definition: A thorough or dramatic change in form, appearance, or character.
exampleEn: The industrial revolution brought about a complete transformation of the economic and social structure of Europe.
exampleKr: 산업 혁명은 유럽의 경제 및 사회 구조의 완전한 변화를 가져왔다.

definition: Relating to, occupying, or having the character of space or physical dimensions.
exampleEn: The architect used 3D modeling software to better understand the spatial relationship between the different rooms.
exampleKr: 그 건축가는 서로 다른 방들 사이의 공간적 관계를 더 잘 이해하기 위해 3D 모델링 소프트웨어를 사용했다.

definition: A numerical or constant factor in an algebraic term or a physical property.
exampleEn: In the equation, the coefficient determines the rate at which the dependent variable changes relative to the independent one.
exampleKr: 방정식에서 계수는 독립 변수에 비해 종속 변수가 변화하는 속도를 결정한다.

definition: The process of moving something from one place to another or converting text from one language to another.
exampleEn: The accurate translation of technical manuals is essential for the safe operation of heavy machinery worldwide.
exampleKr: 기술 매뉴얼의 정확한 번역은 전 세계적으로 중장비의 안전한 작동을 위해 필수적이다.

definition: A thin pliable sheet of material forming a barrier or lining in an organism.
exampleEn: The semi-permeable cell membrane controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell's internal environment.
exampleKr: 반투과성 세포막은 세포의 내부 환경으로 출입하는 물질의 이동을 조절한다.

definition: A specialized cell transmitting nerve impulses; the fundamental unit of the nervous system.
exampleEn: Information is transmitted between neurons through chemical signals released at specialized junctions called synapses.
exampleKr: 정보는 시냅스라고 불리는 특화된 접합부에서 방출되는 화학 신호를 통해 뉴런들 사이에서 전달된다.

definition: The imitation of the operation of a real-world process or system over time.
exampleEn: Pilots undergo extensive training in flight simulations to prepare for emergency situations without any actual risk.
exampleKr: 조종사들은 실제 위험 없이 비상 상황에 대비하기 위해 비행 시뮬레이션에서 광범위한 훈련을 받는다.

definition: Relating to the words or vocabulary of a language as distinguished from its grammar.
exampleEn: The student's lexical knowledge was impressive, but he still struggled with complex grammatical structures in his essays.
exampleKr: 그 학생의 어휘 지식은 인상적이었지만, 그는 여전히 에세이에서 복잡한 문법 구조에 어려움을 겪었다.

definition: A system or planned way of doing things, especially one imposed by a government or authority.
exampleEn: The country established a strict regulatory regime to monitor and limit carbon emissions from industrial factories.
exampleKr: 그 나라는 산업 공장의 탄소 배출을 감시하고 제한하기 위해 엄격한 규제 체제를 구축했다.

definition: The fact or quality of being different, divergent, or inconsistent within a dataset or group.
exampleEn: Statisticians calculated the variance in the test scores to determine how much they deviated from the average.
exampleKr: 통계학자들은 시험 점수가 평균에서 얼마나 벗어났는지 확인하기 위해 점수의 분산을 계산했다.

definition: A group of atoms bonded together, representing the smallest fundamental unit of a chemical compound.
exampleEn: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms covalently bonded to a single oxygen atom.
exampleKr: 물 분자는 하나의 산소 원자에 공유 결합된 두 개의 수소 원자로 구성된다.

definition: An object or sign used to indicate a position, standard, or specific characteristic within a context.
exampleEn: Biological markers in the blood can help doctors detect the presence of certain diseases at an early stage.
exampleKr: 혈액 속의 생물학적 지표는 의사들이 특정 질병의 존재를 초기 단계에 발견하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있다.

definition: Based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory or pure logic.
exampleEn: The scientist provided empirical evidence from multiple experiments to support her groundbreaking new theory.
exampleKr: 그 과학자는 자신의 획기적인 새로운 이론을 뒷받침하기 위해 여러 실험에서 얻은 실증적 증거를 제시했다.

definition: A machine capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically, especially by being programmed.
exampleEn: The manufacturing plant uses advanced robots to perform repetitive tasks with a high degree of precision and speed.
exampleKr: 그 제조 공장은 높은 정밀도와 속도로 반복적인 작업을 수행하기 위해 첨단 로봇을 사용한다.

definition: Relating to the use of statistics or data analysis.
exampleEn: The researcher used statistical analysis to determine the significance of the observed data trends.
exampleKr: 연구원은 관찰된 데이터 추세의 유의성을 결정하기 위해 통계적 분석을 사용했다.

definition: A speech sound produced by a relatively open configuration of the vocal tract.
exampleEn: English vowels can vary significantly in pronunciation depending on the dialect of the speaker.
exampleKr: 영어 모음은 화자의 방언에 따라 발음이 상당히 달라질 수 있다.

definition: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.
exampleEn: Chemical equilibrium occurs when the rates of the forward and backward reactions are equal.
exampleKr: 화학적 평형은 정반응과 역반응의 속도가 같을 때 발생한다.

definition: The quality of being intense or the measurable amount of a property.
exampleEn: The intensity of the light source was measured to ensure it met laboratory standards.
exampleKr: 광원의 강도는 실험실 표준을 충족하는지 확인하기 위해 측정되었다.

definition: A return to a former state, or a statistical method for modeling relationships.
exampleEn: Linear regression is a common tool used to model the relationship between two variables.
exampleKr: 선형 회귀는 두 변수 사이의 관계를 모델링하는 데 사용되는 일반적인 도구이다.

definition: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem.
exampleEn: Early diagnosis of the disease is crucial for improving the chances of a successful recovery.
exampleKr: 질병의 조기 진단은 성공적인 회복 가능성을 높이는 데 매우 중요하다.

definition: The action or process of identifying someone or something.
exampleEn: The identification of specific genes has allowed scientists to better understand hereditary health conditions.
exampleKr: 특정 유전자의 식별은 과학자들이 유전적 건강 상태를 더 잘 이해할 수 있게 해주었다.

definition: A point in a network at which lines or pathways intersect or branch.
exampleEn: Each node in the computer network represents a device that can send and receive data.
exampleKr: 컴퓨터 네트워크의 각 절점은 데이터를 주고받을 수 있는 장치를 나타낸다.

definition: Existing only in part; incomplete.
exampleEn: The experiment yielded only a partial explanation for the phenomenon, requiring further investigation.
exampleKr: 그 실험은 현상에 대해 부분적인 설명만을 제공하여 추가적인 조사가 필요했다.

definition: To have a mutual relationship or connection where things affect each other.
exampleEn: High levels of physical activity often correlate with improved cardiovascular health in adults.
exampleKr: 높은 수준의 신체 활동은 성인의 심혈관 건강 개선과 종종 상관관계가 있다.

definition: The state of being subject to death or the number of deaths.
exampleEn: Public health initiatives aim to reduce infant mortality through better nutrition and medical care.
exampleKr: 공중 보건 계획은 더 나은 영양과 의료 서비스를 통해 영아 사망률을 줄이는 것을 목표로 한다.

definition: A blood protein produced in response to and counteracting a specific antigen.
exampleEn: The immune system produces antibodies to protect the body from harmful bacteria and viruses.
exampleKr: 면역 체계는 유해한 박테리아와 바이러스로부터 몸을 보호하기 위해 항체를 생성한다.

definition: Relating to time or worldly affairs.
exampleEn: Researchers examined the temporal sequence of events to determine the cause of the crash.
exampleKr: 연구원들은 붕괴의 원인을 파악하기 위해 사건의 시간적 순서를 조사했다.

definition: A minute portion of matter or a minor part of speech.
exampleEn: Physicists study subatomic particles to understand the fundamental building blocks of the universe.
exampleKr: 물리학자들은 우주의 근본적인 구성 요소를 이해하기 위해 아원자 입자를 연구한다.

definition: The length of time that something continues or lasts.
exampleEn: The duration of the lecture was extended to allow for a detailed question session.
exampleKr: 강의 지속 시간은 상세한 질의 시간을 갖기 위해 연장되었다.

definition: Relating to behavior or the way in which one acts.
exampleEn: Behavioral psychology focuses on how environmental factors influence the actions of individuals.
exampleKr: 행동 심리학은 환경적 요인이 개인의 행동에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지에 초점을 맞춘다.

definition: The action of using up a resource or eating and drinking.
exampleEn: Reducing energy consumption is essential for achieving long-term environmental sustainability and efficiency.
exampleKr: 에너지 소비를 줄이는 것은 장기적인 환경 지속 가능성과 효율성을 달성하는 데 필수적이다.

definition: Speaking two languages fluently or written in two languages.

definition: Of a minimum amount, quantity, or degree; negligible or smallest possible.

definition: Done or acting according to a fixed plan or system; methodical.

definition: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

definition: The combination of ideas to form a theory or system, or the production of chemical compounds.

definition: An estimate or forecast of a future situation based on a study of present trends.

definition: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle.

definition: A solid or hollow object which tapers from a circular or roughly circular base to a point.

definition: The state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else.

definition: An individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form.

definition: The process of coming into view or becoming exposed after being concealed.

definition: To extend over so as to cover partly; to have some elements in common.

definition: The act of replacing one thing or person with another.

definition: In a way that is clear and direct, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.

definition: Plain or obvious to see or understand from the available facts.

exampleKr: 종합적인 실험 데이터를 분석한 후 초기 가설이 틀렸다는 것이 분명해졌다.

definition: Relating to or based on mental concepts or abstract ideas.

definition: The action or process of identifying the presence of something hidden or subtle.

definition: To act in such a way as to have an effect on another thing or person.

definition: Relating to a nerve or the entire nervous system of a living organism.

exampleKr: 인공 신경망은 인간의 뇌가 복잡한 정보를 처리하는 방식을 모방하도록 설계되었다.

definition: Persisting for a long time or constantly recurring in a negative way.

definition: Necessary to make a whole complete or essential to a process.

definition: A substance produced by a living organism that acts as a catalyst for biochemical reactions.

definition: The action of conceiving a child or the forming of an idea in the mind.

definition: A prefix or informal term referring to a former status or partner.

definition: A system of ideas and ideals, especially one that forms the basis of economic or political policy.

definition: The male reproductive cell that fertilizes an egg to produce an embryo.

definition: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quantity or number of something.

definition: A round solid figure or a particular field of activity, interest, or influence.

definition: The state of being unstable or lacking predictability and reliable control.

definition: To intervene between people in a dispute in order to bring about an agreement.

definition: A detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.

definition: To arrange a group of things in classes according to shared qualities or characteristics.

definition: A person qualified to practice medicine, especially one who specializes in diagnosis and treatment.

definition: The action of mathematical calculation or the use of computers for data processing.

definition: Spoken rather than written, or relating to the mouth.

definition: Being at or near the middle point or part of something.

definition: A thing that points out or shows the state or level of something.

definition: Relating to the gradual development of something, especially over generations.

definition: Information about reactions to a product or a person's performance used for improvement.

definition: A small or tiny part, amount, or proportion of something.

definition: Not involving a direct, proportional relationship between independent and dependent variables.

definition: The action of departing from an established course or accepted standard.

definition: Closely and neatly packed together; dense or small in size.

definition: Relating to or characteristic of the tropics or a very hot and humid climate.

definition: The study of the forms of things, particularly organisms or words.

definition: By that means or as a result of that action.

definition: The arrangement of words and phrases to create well-formed sentences in a language.

definition: A shortcoming, imperfection, or lack that causes something to be inadequate.

definition: The action or state of moving or being moved apart.

definition: The process of coming together from different directions to meet at a point.

definition: To a degree that is enough or adequate for a particular purpose.

definition: Having a sound basis in logic or fact; officially acceptable or binding.

definition: A point where two systems, subjects, or organizations meet and interact.

definition: To fix an object firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass or environment.

definition: Present or experienced to a severe or intense degree; sharp or insightful.

definition: The state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial in a specific context.

definition: A thing that completes or brings to perfection another thing it is paired with.

definition: The flattened green structure of a plant that is the primary site of photosynthesis.

definition: Relating to or in the form of words, especially as opposed to actions or images.

definition: A whole formed by combining several separate elements or individual parts.

definition: The state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities.

definition: Appearing or occurring at intervals; happening from time to time.

definition: To come together from different directions so as eventually to meet.
exampleEn: Several different lines of evidence converge to support the theory that the climate is changing rapidly.
exampleKr: 여러 다른 증거들이 기후가 급격히 변화하고 있다는 이론을 뒷받침하기 위해 하나로 수렴됩니다.

definition: Relating to a fetus (an unborn offspring of a mammal).
exampleEn: Exposure to certain chemicals during the fetal stage of development can lead to long-term health complications.
exampleKr: 발달의 태아 단계 동안 특정 화학 물질에 노출되는 것은 장기적인 건강 합병증으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

definition: The action or capability of understanding something.
exampleEn: The reading comprehension section of the exam tests the student's ability to identify the main idea.
exampleKr: 시험의 독해 부분은 주제를 파악하는 학생의 능력을 테스트합니다.

definition: Implied though not plainly or directly expressed.
exampleEn: The speaker's criticism was implicit, as she never directly mentioned the flaws in the current proposal.
exampleKr: 발표자는 현재 제안의 결함을 직접적으로 언급하지 않았기 때문에 그녀의 비판은 암시적이었습니다.

definition: The full extent of something from end to end; the length of time something lasts.
exampleEn: The average life span of this species has increased significantly due to improvements in veterinary medicine.
exampleKr: 수의학의 발전 덕분에 이 종의 평균 수명이 크게 증가했습니다.

definition: A colorless, odorless reactive gas that is the life-supporting component of the air.
exampleEn: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to convert carbon dioxide into oxygen.
exampleKr: 광합성은 녹색 식물이 햇빛을 이용해 이산화탄소를 산소로 전환하는 과정입니다.

definition: The action of devising or creating something in a systematic way.
exampleEn: The precise formulation of the hypothesis is a critical step in the scientific method of inquiry.
exampleKr: 가설의 정밀한 공식화는 과학적 탐구 방법에서 중요한 단계입니다.

definition: A particular form of a language which is peculiar to a specific region or social group.
exampleEn: Linguists are documenting the unique dialect spoken in the remote mountain village before it disappears entirely.
exampleKr: 언어학자들은 외딴 산골 마을에서 사용되는 독특한 방언이 완전히 사라지기 전에 이를 기록하고 있습니다.

definition: A group of people or animals of one kind living together.
exampleEn: The researchers observed a large colony of penguins to study their social interactions and nesting habits.
exampleKr: 연구원들은 펭귄들의 사회적 상호작용과 둥지 틀기 습성을 연구하기 위해 대규모 펭귄 군집을 관찰했습니다.

definition: Resistant to a particular infection or toxin owing to the presence of specific antibodies.
exampleEn: Vaccinations help the body's immune system recognize and fight off specific pathogens more effectively.
exampleKr: 예방 접종은 신체의 면역 체계가 특정 병원균을 더 효과적으로 인식하고 싸워 이기도록 돕습니다.

definition: A shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself; a sequence of instructions that repeats.
exampleEn: The programmer used a recursive loop to process the data until the desired condition was finally met.
exampleKr: 프로그래머는 원하는 조건이 마침내 충족될 때까지 데이터를 처리하기 위해 재귀 루프를 사용했습니다.

definition: The part of mathematics in which letters and other general symbols are used to represent numbers.
exampleEn: Linear algebra is a branch of mathematics that deals with vectors, matrices, and systems of equations.
exampleKr: 선형 대수학은 벡터, 행렬 및 방정식 계를 다루는 수학의 한 분야입니다.

definition: Something that is based on or source from another thing; the rate of change of a function.
exampleEn: In mathematics, the derivative represents the rate at which a function's value changes at a specific point.
exampleKr: 수학에서 미분 계수(파생값)는 특정 지점에서 함수의 값이 변하는 비율을 나타냅니다.

definition: A section of additional information at the end of a book or document.
exampleEn: For more detailed statistical data, please refer to the appendix at the end of the research report.
exampleKr: 더 자세한 통계 데이터는 연구 보고서 끝에 있는 부록을 참조하십시오.

definition: A general review or summary of a subject.
exampleEn: The introductory chapter provides a brief overview of the historical context surrounding the industrial revolution.
exampleKr: 도입 장은 산업 혁명을 둘러싼 역사적 맥락에 대한 간략한 개요를 제공합니다.

definition: The spreading of something more widely.
exampleEn: The diffusion of innovation theory explains how new ideas and technologies spread through a social system.
exampleKr: 혁신 확산 이론은 새로운 아이디어와 기술이 사회 시스템을 통해 어떻게 퍼져나가는지 설명합니다.

definition: An individual animal, plant, piece of a mineral, etc., used as an example of its species or type.
exampleEn: The museum houses a rare specimen of a prehistoric bird that was discovered in the desert.
exampleKr: 그 박물관은 사막에서 발견된 선사 시대 새의 희귀한 표본을 소장하고 있습니다.

definition: To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.
exampleEn: The philosopher continues to assert that human beings possess an inherent sense of morality from birth.
exampleKr: 그 철학자는 인간이 태어날 때부터 타고난 도덕 관념을 가지고 있다고 계속해서 주장합니다.

definition: Found or distributed over a large area or among many people.
exampleEn: There is widespread concern among scientists regarding the impact of plastic pollution on marine ecosystems.
exampleKr: 플라스틱 오염이 해양 생태계에 미치는 영향에 대해 과학자들 사이에 광범위한 우려가 있습니다.

definition: The ability to do something successfully or efficiently.
exampleEn: The program aims to enhance the linguistic competence of students who are learning English as a second language.
exampleKr: 이 프로그램은 영어를 제2언어로 배우는 학생들의 언어 능력을 향상시키는 것을 목표로 합니다.

definition: Remaining after the greater part or quantity has gone.
exampleEn: Even after the cleaning process, some residual traces of the chemical were still detectable in the soil.
exampleKr: 정화 과정 후에도 화학 물질의 일부 잔류 흔적이 토양에서 여전히 검출되었습니다.

definition: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.
exampleEn: Nuclear fusion is the process that powers stars by combining light atomic nuclei to form heavier ones.
exampleKr: 핵융합은 가벼운 원자핵을 결합하여 더 무거운 원자핵을 형성함으로써 별에 에너지를 공급하는 과정입니다.

definition: The protection of plants and animals, natural areas, or historical buildings.
exampleEn: The conservation of natural resources is essential for maintaining ecological balance and ensuring a sustainable future.
exampleKr: 천연자원의 보존은 생태계 균형을 유지하고 지속 가능한 미래를 보장하는 데 필수적입니다.

definition: To severely restrict the scope, extent, or activity of something.
exampleEn: Financial limitations often constrain the ability of small businesses to invest in new technology and equipment.
exampleKr: 재정적 한계는 종종 소규모 기업이 새로운 기술과 장비에 투자하는 능력을 제한합니다.

definition: Behavior showing high moral standards; a good or useful quality of a thing.
exampleEn: Patience is often considered a virtue in academic research, as results can take years to achieve.
exampleKr: 학술 연구에서 인내는 종종 미덕으로 여겨지는데, 결과가 나오기까지 수년이 걸릴 수 있기 때문입니다.

definition: To recognize or ascertain what makes someone or something different.
exampleEn: It is important to differentiate between primary sources and secondary sources when conducting historical research.
exampleKr: 역사 연구를 수행할 때 1차 사료와 2차 사료를 구별하는 것이 중요합니다.

definition: Relating to the group -NH2 or to an organic compound containing this group.
exampleEn: Amino acids are the fundamental building blocks of proteins, which are essential for all living organisms.
exampleKr: 아미노산은 단백질의 기본 구성 요소이며, 이는 모든 생물체에 필수적입니다.

definition: To some extent; in some degree; not totally.
exampleEn: The project was only partially successful because it failed to meet the initial budget and timeline.
exampleKr: 그 프로젝트는 초기 예산과 일정을 맞추지 못했기 때문에 부분적으로만 성공적이었습니다.

definition: Coming before a more important action or event, especially as a preparation.
exampleEn: Preliminary results suggest that the new drug might be effective in treating the virus.
exampleKr: 예비 결과는 신약이 바이러스 치료에 효과적일 수 있음을 시사합니다.

definition: Relating to the study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence.
exampleEn: The professor engaged the students in a deep philosophical debate about the nature of reality.
exampleKr: 교수는 학생들과 함께 실재의 본질에 관한 깊은 철학적 토론을 벌였습니다.

definition: A prefix meaning before in time, place, order, or importance.
exampleEn: The pre-experimental phase is crucial for establishing a baseline for the upcoming scientific study.
exampleKr: 실험 전 단계는 다가올 과학 연구의 기준선을 설정하는 데 매우 중요합니다.

definition: An instance of buying or selling something, or a business deal.
exampleEn: Online banking systems must ensure that every financial transaction is encrypted and securely processed.
exampleKr: 온라인 뱅킹 시스템은 모든 금융 거래가 암호화되고 안전하게 처리되도록 보장해야 합니다.

definition: Important or famous, or standing out so as to be easily seen.
exampleEn: Several prominent scholars contributed their insights to the latest edition of the academic journal.
exampleKr: 여러 저명한 학자들이 해당 학술지의 최신판에 자신들의 통찰을 기고했습니다.

definition: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
exampleEn: The researchers studied the traditional medicine practices of the indigenous tribes in the Amazon rainforest.
exampleKr: 연구원들은 아마존 열대우림 토착 부족들의 전통 의학 관습을 연구했습니다.

definition: To cause someone or something to be in a particular state.
exampleEn: The heavy rain rendered the mountain roads impassable, delaying the delivery of essential supplies.
exampleKr: 폭우로 인해 산길이 통행 불가능하게 되어 필수 물자 공급이 지연되었습니다.

definition: In a way that is free from outside control or influence.
exampleEn: Students are encouraged to work independently on their research projects to develop critical thinking skills.
exampleKr: 학생들은 비판적 사고 능력을 키우기 위해 연구 프로젝트를 독립적으로 수행하도록 권장됩니다.

definition: Serving as a visible symbol for something abstract.
exampleEn: The white dove is widely recognized as a symbolic representation of peace across many cultures.
exampleKr: 흰 비둘기는 많은 문화권에서 평화의 상징적 표현으로 널리 인식됩니다.

definition: To make practical and effective use of something.
exampleEn: Modern agriculture must utilize advanced technology to increase crop yields and ensure global food security.
exampleKr: 현대 농업은 작물 수확량을 늘리고 세계 식량 안보를 보장하기 위해 첨단 기술을 활용해야 합니다.

definition: Relating to the branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms.
exampleEn: Sleep deprivation can lead to various physiological issues, including weakened immunity and increased stress levels.
exampleKr: 수면 부족은 면역력 약화와 스트레스 수치 증가를 포함한 다양한 생리적 문제를 일으킬 수 있습니다.

definition: Not directly caused by or resulting from something.
exampleEn: The tax increase had an indirect impact on consumer spending patterns throughout the fiscal year.
exampleKr: 세금 인상은 해당 회계 연도 동안 소비자 지출 패턴에 간접적인 영향을 미쳤습니다.

definition: A silver-white metal that is essential for the growth of healthy teeth and bones.
exampleEn: Calcium is an essential mineral required for maintaining strong bones and healthy nerve function.
exampleKr: 칼슘은 튼튼한 뼈와 건강한 신경 기능을 유지하는 데 필요한 필수 미네랄입니다.

definition: The action of gathering together as a group or the process of putting parts together.
exampleEn: The automated assembly line significantly reduced the time required to manufacture complex electronic devices.
exampleKr: 자동 조립 라인은 복잡한 전자 기기를 제조하는 데 필요한 시간을 크게 단축했습니다.

definition: In a way that involves rigid enforcement of rules or standards.
exampleEn: The laboratory safety protocols must be strictly followed to prevent any accidental exposure to chemicals.
exampleKr: 화학 물질에 대한 우발적인 노출을 방지하기 위해 실험실 안전 수칙을 엄격히 준수해야 합니다.

definition: The state of being united or joined as a whole.
exampleEn: The national anthem serves as a powerful symbol of unity and pride for the citizens.
exampleKr: 국가는 시민들에게 통합과 자부심의 강력한 상징 역할을 합니다.

definition: Relating to mental illness or its treatment.
exampleEn: The patient was admitted to the psychiatric ward for further evaluation and specialized mental treatment.
exampleKr: 환자는 추가 평가와 전문적인 정신 치료를 위해 정신과 병동에 입원했습니다.

definition: A detailed analysis and assessment of something, especially a literary or artistic work.
exampleEn: The academic journal published a detailed critique of the methodology used in the recent study.
exampleKr: 해당 학술지는 최근 연구에서 사용된 방법론에 대한 상세한 비평을 게재했습니다.

definition: The action or process of distinguishing between two or more things or people.
exampleEn: Cell differentiation is a fundamental process where unspecialized cells develop into specific types of cells.
exampleKr: 세포 분화는 미분화된 세포가 특정 유형의 세포로 발달하는 근본적인 과정입니다.

definition: The act of closing or state of being closed; the end of something.
exampleEn: The sudden closure of the factory left hundreds of workers without employment and financial stability.
exampleKr: 공장의 갑작스러운 폐쇄로 인해 수백 명의 노동자들이 일자리와 재정적 안정을 잃었습니다.

definition: To reduce something, especially something unwanted, to the smallest possible amount or degree.
exampleEn: Engineers are working to minimize the environmental impact of the new highway construction project.
exampleKr: 엔지니어들은 새로운 고속도로 건설 프로젝트의 환경적 영향을 최소화하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.

definition: Relating to or involving the selection of the most suitable or best qualified.
exampleEn: Universities often have a selective admissions process to ensure they enroll the most qualified candidates.
exampleKr: 대학교들은 가장 자질 있는 후보자를 등록시키기 위해 종종 선택적인 입학 절차를 거칩니다.

definition: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.
exampleEn: The availability of clean drinking water is a critical issue for many developing nations today.
exampleKr: 깨끗한 식수의 이용 가능성은 오늘날 많은 개발도상국에 있어 중대한 문제입니다.

definition: To represent or show something in a picture, story, or other work of art.
exampleEn: The historical novel aims to accurately depict the daily lives of people during the Renaissance.
exampleKr: 그 역사 소설은 르네상스 시대 사람들의 일상생활을 정확하게 묘사하는 것을 목표로 합니다.

definition: A thing said or done that serves as a signal to an actor or other person to enter or begin something.
exampleEn: Visual cues play a significant role in how humans perceive and interact with their environment.
exampleKr: 시각적 신호는 인간이 환경을 인식하고 상호작용하는 방식에 중요한 역할을 합니다.

definition: Relating to a parent or parents.
exampleEn: Parental involvement in a child's education is often linked to higher academic achievement and success.
exampleKr: 자녀 교육에 대한 부모의 참여는 종종 더 높은 학업 성취도 및 성공과 연결됩니다.

definition: A religious or solemn ceremony consisting of a series of actions performed according to a prescribed order.
exampleEn: Many ancient civilizations performed complex rituals to honor their gods and ensure a good harvest.
exampleKr: 많은 고대 문명들은 신을 공경하고 풍작을 기원하기 위해 복잡한 의식을 수행했습니다.

definition: The quality of being fertile; the ability to conceive children or young.
exampleEn: The fertility of the soil in this region makes it ideal for large-scale agricultural production.
exampleKr: 이 지역 토양의 비옥함은 대규모 농업 생산에 이상적입니다.

definition: Next to or adjoining something else.
exampleEn: The library is located in the building adjacent to the main science laboratory on campus.
exampleKr: 도서관은 캠퍼스 내 주요 과학 실험실에 인접한 건물에 위치해 있습니다.

definition: Without hesitation or difficulty; easily.
exampleEn: Information is now readily available to anyone with an internet connection and a digital device.
exampleKr: 이제 인터넷 연결과 디지털 기기가 있는 사람이라면 누구나 정보를 손쉽게 이용할 수 있습니다.

definition: A person who watches or notices something.
exampleEn: An independent observer was present during the experiment to ensure that all procedures were followed.
exampleKr: 모든 절차가 준수되었는지 확인하기 위해 실험 중에 독립적인 관찰자가 배석했습니다.

definition: A feeling that makes one self-conscious and unable to act in a relaxed and natural way.
exampleEn: Social anxiety can lead to the inhibition of natural behavior in group settings and public events.
exampleKr: 사회적 불안은 집단 환경이나 공공 행사에서 자연스러운 행동의 억제로 이어질 수 있습니다.

definition: A set of printed or written questions with a choice of answers, devised for the purposes of a survey.
exampleEn: Participants were asked to complete a detailed questionnaire regarding their dietary habits and lifestyle choices.
exampleKr: 참가자들은 자신의 식습관과 생활 방식 선택에 관한 상세한 설문지를 작성하도록 요청받았습니다.

definition: A general statement or concept obtained by inference from specific cases.
exampleEn: It is dangerous to make a broad generalization about a group based on limited individual experiences.
exampleKr: 한정된 개인적 경험에 근거하여 집단에 대해 폭넓은 일반화를 하는 것은 위험합니다.

definition: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quality of something rather than its quantity.
exampleEn: Qualitative research focuses on understanding human behavior through interviews and observations rather than numerical data.
exampleKr: 질적 연구는 수치 데이터보다는 인터뷰와 관찰을 통해 인간의 행동을 이해하는 데 집중합니다.

definition: Stretched tight or rigid; showing or causing mental or emotional strain.
exampleEn: The atmosphere in the meeting room became tense as the deadline for the project approached.
exampleKr: 프로젝트 마감 기한이 다가오자 회의실 분위기가 긴장되었습니다.

definition: A written or printed representation of something; the process of copying something.
exampleEn: The transcription of the DNA sequence is the first step in the process of protein synthesis.
exampleKr: DNA 서열의 전사는 단백질 합성 과정의 첫 번째 단계입니다.

definition: With reference to a particular area or one's neighborhood.
exampleEn: Supporting locally grown produce helps reduce carbon emissions associated with long-distance transportation of food.
exampleKr: 지역에서 재배된 농산물을 지원하는 것은 식품의 장거리 운송과 관련된 탄소 배출을 줄이는 데 도움이 됩니다.

definition: A substance that provides nourishment essential for growth and the maintenance of life.
exampleEn: Plants absorb essential nutrients from the soil to support their growth and overall biological health.
exampleKr: 식물은 성장과 전반적인 생물학적 건강을 유지하기 위해 토양에서 필수 영양소를 흡수합니다.

definition: To strengthen or support, especially with additional personnel or material.
exampleEn: The teacher used positive feedback to reinforce the students' efforts and encourage further academic progress.
exampleKr: 교사는 학생들의 노력을 강화하고 추가적인 학업 발전을 독려하기 위해 긍정적인 피드백을 사용했습니다.

definition: In a way that relates to the use of statistics.
exampleEn: The study found that the results were statistically significant, indicating a clear trend in the data.
exampleKr: 해당 연구는 결과가 통계적으로 유의미하다는 것을 발견했으며, 이는 데이터의 명확한 추세를 나타냅니다.

definition: To imitate the appearance or character of something.
exampleEn: Pilots use advanced flight simulators to train for emergency situations without any actual physical risk.
exampleKr: 조종사들은 실제적인 물리적 위험 없이 비상 상황에 대비하기 위해 고급 비행 시뮬레이터를 사용합니다.

definition: Closely compacted in substance; having parts that are packed together closely.
exampleEn: Tropical rainforests are known for their dense vegetation and incredibly high levels of biological diversity.
exampleKr: 열대우림은 빽빽한 식생과 믿을 수 없을 정도로 높은 수준의 생물 다양성으로 알려져 있습니다.

definition: The branch of biology that deals with the relations of organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.
exampleEn: The study of ecology helps us understand the complex interactions between organisms and their environment.
exampleKr: 생태학 연구는 유기체와 그들 환경 사이의 복잡한 상호작용을 이해하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

definition: Having no legal or binding force; invalid.
exampleEn: The researchers failed to reject the null hypothesis, suggesting no significant difference between the groups.
exampleKr: 연구원들은 귀무 가설(영 가설)을 기각하지 못했으며, 이는 집단 간에 유의미한 차이가 없음을 시사합니다.

definition: Relating to or occurring at the end of something; predicted to lead to death.
exampleEn: The patient was diagnosed with a terminal illness and received palliative care to manage the symptoms.
exampleKr: 그 환자는 불치병 진단을 받았고 증상 관리를 위해 완화 치료를 받았습니다.

definition: Having a relaxed, friendly, or unofficial style, manner, or nature.
exampleEn: An informal meeting was held to discuss the initial ideas before the official project proposal.
exampleKr: 공식적인 프로젝트 제안 전에 초기 아이디어를 논의하기 위해 비공식적인 회의가 열렸습니다.

definition: To tell someone officially that they can or must leave, or to release a substance.
exampleEn: The factory was fined for failing to properly treat the chemical waste before its final discharge.
exampleKr: 그 공장은 화학 폐기물을 최종 방출하기 전에 적절히 처리하지 않아 벌금을 물었습니다.

definition: Able to change in order to fit different conditions.
exampleEn: Evolutionary biology explores how species develop adaptive traits to survive in changing environmental conditions.
exampleKr: 진화 생물학은 종이 변화하는 환경 조건에서 살아남기 위해 어떻게 적응적 특성을 발달시키는지 탐구합니다.

definition: Relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.
exampleEn: Climate change poses a major ecological threat to the delicate balance of many natural habitats.
exampleKr: 기후 변화는 많은 자연 서식지의 섬세한 균형에 중대한 생태학적 위협이 됩니다.

definition: A formal set of rules or procedures to be followed in a specific situation.
exampleEn: Adhering to the established experimental protocol is essential for ensuring the reliability of research results.
exampleKr: 수립된 실험 절차를 준수하는 것은 연구 결과의 신뢰성을 보장하는 데 필수적이다.

definition: Favoring or implementing social reform or new, liberal ideas.
exampleEn: The university implemented a progressive curriculum designed to foster critical thinking and global awareness among students.
exampleKr: 그 대학교는 학생들 사이에서 비판적 사고와 글로벌 의식을 함양하기 위해 설계된 진보적인 커리큘럼을 시행했다.

definition: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beauty, especially in art.
exampleEn: The architect focused on the aesthetic appeal of the building while maintaining its structural integrity and functionality.
exampleKr: 건축가는 건물의 구조적 온전함과 기능성을 유지하면서도 건물의 미적 매력에 집중했다.

definition: To make use of a situation or resource in a way considered unfair or selfish.
exampleEn: Many corporations seek to exploit natural resources in developing nations to maximize their annual profit margins.
exampleKr: 많은 기업들이 연간 이윤 폭을 극대화하기 위해 개발도상국의 천연자원을 이용하려 한다.

definition: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil and rearing of animals.
exampleEn: Sustainable agriculture practices are necessary to provide food security for the growing global population in the future.
exampleKr: 미래의 증가하는 세계 인구에게 식량 안보를 제공하기 위해서는 지속 가능한 농업 관행이 필요하다.

definition: A person actively engaged in an art, discipline, or profession, especially medicine.
exampleEn: The workshop was designed for medical practitioners who wish to update their knowledge on modern surgical techniques.
exampleKr: 이 워크숍은 현대적인 수술 기법에 대한 지식을 갱신하고자 하는 의료 종사자들을 위해 설계되었다.

definition: A job or profession that occupies a person's time and provides a livelihood.
exampleEn: Choosing a stable occupation is often a primary concern for students entering the competitive modern job market.
exampleKr: 안정적인 직업을 선택하는 것은 경쟁적인 현대 구직 시장에 진입하는 학생들에게 종종 주요 관심사이다.

definition: The state or condition of being equal in value, amount, function, or meaning.
exampleEn: The researcher established a functional equivalence between the two different methods of measuring cognitive performance.
exampleKr: 연구자는 인지 능력을 측정하는 두 가지 서로 다른 방법 사이의 기능적 등가성을 확립했다.

definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical considerations.
exampleEn: A pragmatic approach to solving the economic crisis involves balancing immediate needs with long-term fiscal stability.
exampleKr: 경제 위기를 해결하기 위한 실용적인 접근 방식은 즉각적인 필요와 장기적인 재정 안정 사이의 균형을 맞추는 것을 포함한다.

definition: The effectiveness of productive effort, especially in industry, as measured by the rate of output.
exampleEn: Technological advancements in the workplace have significantly increased the overall productivity of the manufacturing sector.
exampleKr: 작업 현장의 기술적 발전은 제조업 부문의 전반적인 생산성을 크게 향상시켰다.

definition: A symbol used to show direction, typically consisting of a straight line with a pointed end.
exampleEn: The diagram uses a red arrow to indicate the direction of the chemical reaction within the system.
exampleKr: 도표는 시스템 내에서의 화학 반응 방향을 나타내기 위해 빨간색 화살표를 사용한다.

definition: To produce a copy of something or to produce offspring.
exampleEn: Scientists must be able to reproduce the experimental findings to confirm the validity of the original study.
exampleKr: 과학자들은 원래 연구의 타당성을 확인하기 위해 실험 결과를 재현할 수 있어야 한다.

definition: An expression of opinions or an offering of explanations about an event or situation.
exampleEn: The professor provided a detailed commentary on the historical context of the newly discovered ancient manuscript.
exampleKr: 교수는 새로 발견된 고대 사본의 역사적 맥락에 대해 상세한 해설을 제공했다.

definition: A small amount of something that remains after the main part has gone or been taken.
exampleEn: After the chemical evaporation process was complete, a thin white residue remained at the bottom of the beaker.
exampleKr: 화학적 증발 과정이 완료된 후, 비커 바닥에는 얇은 흰색 잔여물이 남았다.

definition: Prone to change, fail, or give way; not stable.
exampleEn: The political situation in the region remains unstable, leading to concerns about potential social and economic unrest.
exampleKr: 해당 지역의 정치 상황은 여전히 불안정하여 잠재적인 사회적, 경제적 불안에 대한 우려를 낳고 있다.

definition: A general agreement among a group of people.
exampleEn: The committee reached a consensus after several hours of debate regarding the new environmental protection policy.
exampleKr: 위원회는 새로운 환경 보호 정책에 관한 몇 시간의 토론 끝에 합의에 도달했다.

definition: To make something easier to do or understand.
exampleEn: The author attempted to simplify complex scientific theories to make them more accessible to a general audience.
exampleKr: 저자는 복잡한 과학 이론을 일반 청중이 더 쉽게 이해할 수 있도록 단순화하려고 시도했다.

definition: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.
exampleEn: The emergency evacuation plan covers all residential areas within a five-mile radius of the industrial plant.
exampleKr: 비상 대피 계획은 산업 공장 반경 5마일 이내의 모든 주거 지역을 포괄한다.

definition: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally.
exampleEn: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing the way researchers analyze vast amounts of data in various scientific fields.
exampleKr: 인공지능은 연구자들이 다양한 과학 분야에서 방대한 양의 데이터를 분석하는 방식을 혁신하고 있다.

definition: The process or period of gathering in crops.
exampleEn: Farmers are concerned that the unexpected late frost will negatively impact the annual harvest of cereal crops.
exampleKr: 농부들은 예상치 못한 늦서리가 곡물 작물의 연간 수확에 부정적인 영향을 미칠까 봐 걱정하고 있다.

definition: The act of intentionally taking one's own life.
exampleEn: Public health initiatives aim to reduce the suicide rate by providing better mental health support and resources.
exampleKr: 공공 보건 계획은 더 나은 정신 건강 지원과 자원을 제공함으로써 자살률을 낮추는 것을 목표로 한다.

definition: The numerical value of the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter.
exampleEn: The constant pi represents the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter in Euclidean geometry.
exampleKr: 상수 파이는 유클리드 기하학에서 원의 둘레와 지름의 비율을 나타낸다.

definition: A small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail and lives in trees.
exampleEn: Researchers observed the social behavior of the monkey troop to understand the evolutionary roots of cooperation.
exampleKr: 연구자들은 협력의 진화적 뿌리를 이해하기 위해 원숭이 무리의 사회적 행동을 관찰했다.

definition: The natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism.
exampleEn: Destruction of the natural habitat is the primary threat to the survival of many endangered animal species.
exampleKr: 천연 서식지의 파괴는 많은 멸종 위기 동물 종의 생존에 대한 주요 위협이다.

definition: A task or piece of work allocated to someone as part of a job or course of study.
exampleEn: Students are required to submit their final written assignment before the end of the current academic semester.
exampleKr: 학생들은 이번 학기가 끝나기 전에 최종 서면 과제를 제출해야 한다.

definition: To make an exact copy of; to reproduce or repeat.
exampleEn: It is difficult to replicate the exact conditions of the original experiment in a different laboratory setting.
exampleKr: 다른 실험실 환경에서 원래 실험의 정확한 조건을 복제하는 것은 어렵다.

definition: Relating to machines or mechanisms.
exampleEn: The engineer identified a mechanical failure in the engine that caused the unexpected shutdown of the machine.
exampleKr: 엔지니어는 기계의 예기치 않은 정지를 초래한 엔진의 기계적 결함을 확인했다.

definition: A physical or mental condition that limits a person's movements, senses, or activities.
exampleEn: The new policy aims to provide equal opportunities and better accessibility for students living with a physical disability.
exampleKr: 새로운 정책은 신체적 장애를 가진 학생들에게 평등한 기회와 더 나은 접근성을 제공하는 것을 목표로 한다.

definition: Large ruminant animals with horns and cloven hoofs, domesticated for meat or milk.
exampleEn: Large-scale cattle ranching has been identified as a major contributor to deforestation in the Amazon rainforest.
exampleKr: 대규모 소 사육은 아마존 열대우림의 삼림 파괴에 기여하는 주요 요인으로 확인되었다.

definition: Entirely; exclusively; for no other reason.
exampleEn: The decision to relocate the headquarters was based purely on financial considerations rather than operational efficiency.
exampleKr: 본사를 이전하기로 한 결정은 운영 효율성보다는 순전히 재정적인 고려에 근거한 것이었다.

definition: A combination of statements, ideas, or features which are opposed to one another.
exampleEn: There is a clear contradiction between the witness's testimony and the physical evidence presented in court.
exampleKr: 증인의 증언과 법정에 제출된 물리적 증거 사이에는 분명한 모순이 존재한다.

definition: To throw in various random directions; to disperse.
exampleEn: The wind caused the seeds to scatter across the field, leading to uneven growth of the plants.
exampleKr: 바람으로 인해 씨앗이 들판에 흩뿌려졌고, 이는 식물들의 불균일한 성장으로 이어졌다.

definition: Constituting or presenting a problem or difficulty.
exampleEn: The lack of diverse representation in the study's sample group makes the generalized findings quite problematic.
exampleKr: 연구 표본 집단에서 다양한 대표성이 부족하다는 점은 일반화된 연구 결과를 상당히 문제 있게 만든다.

definition: The action or process of correcting something.
exampleEn: The editor made a minor correction to the manuscript to ensure that the grammatical structure was accurate.
exampleKr: 편집자는 문법 구조가 정확한지 확인하기 위해 원고에 사소한 수정을 가했다.

definition: The scientific study of language and its structure.
exampleEn: Linguistics is the scientific study of language, encompassing its structure, meaning, and context of use.
exampleKr: 언어학은 언어의 구조, 의미, 사용 맥락을 아우르는 언어에 대한 과학적 연구이다.

definition: A regulatory substance produced in an organism and transported in tissue fluids to stimulate specific cells.
exampleEn: Insulin is a vital hormone produced by the pancreas that regulates the level of glucose in the blood.
exampleKr: 인슐린은 췌장에서 생성되어 혈액 속의 포도당 수치를 조절하는 필수적인 호르몬이다.

definition: Relating to, denoting, or preserving the character of an early stage in the evolutionary or historical development.
exampleEn: Early humans used primitive tools made of stone and bone to hunt animals and gather food.
exampleKr: 초기 인류는 동물을 사냥하고 음식을 채집하기 위해 돌과 뼈로 만든 원시적인 도구를 사용했다.

definition: Moral principles that govern a person's behavior or the conducting of an activity.
exampleEn: Medical ethics require doctors to prioritize the well-being and autonomy of their patients during any treatment.
exampleKr: 의료 윤리는 의사들이 어떤 치료 과정에서도 환자의 안녕과 자율성을 우선시할 것을 요구한다.

definition: The acquisition or gradual gathering of something.
exampleEn: The accumulation of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere is the primary driver of contemporary global climate change.
exampleKr: 대기 중 온실가스의 축적은 현대 지구 기후 변화의 주요 원인이다.

definition: Lacking in movement, action, or change, especially in a way viewed as undesirable or uninteresting.
exampleEn: The population growth rate remained static for several years before beginning to decline due to economic factors.
exampleKr: 인구 성장률은 경제적 요인으로 인해 감소하기 시작하기 전까지 몇 년 동안 정체된 상태를 유지했다.

definition: Permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.
exampleEn: Researchers must obtain informed consent from all participants before involving them in any clinical trial or study.
exampleKr: 연구자들은 임상 시험이나 연구에 참여시키기 전에 모든 참가자로부터 고지된 동의를 얻어야 한다.

definition: A substance or layer that underlies something, or on which an enzyme acts.
exampleEn: The enzyme binds to its specific substrate to catalyze a chemical reaction within the biological system.
exampleKr: 효소는 생물학적 시스템 내에서 화학 반응을 촉매하기 위해 특정 기질에 결합한다.

definition: Uncomplicated and easy to do or understand.
exampleEn: The instructions for the laboratory experiment were straightforward, allowing the students to complete the task efficiently.
exampleKr: 실험실 실험에 대한 지침은 간단명료하여 학생들이 과업을 효율적으로 완수할 수 있게 해주었다.

definition: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.
exampleEn: The law prohibits discrimination in the workplace based on race, gender, religion, or national origin.
exampleKr: 법은 인종, 성별, 종교 또는 출신 국가에 근거한 직장 내 차별을 금지한다.

definition: As a separate entity or part; not together.
exampleEn: The two variables were analyzed separately to determine their individual impact on the overall outcome of the experiment.
exampleKr: 실험의 전체 결과에 미치는 개별적인 영향을 결정하기 위해 두 변수를 따로 분석했다.

definition: To make unpredictable, unsystematic, or random in order or arrangement.
exampleEn: To avoid bias, the software will randomize the order of questions presented to each participant in the survey.
exampleKr: 편향을 피하기 위해 소프트웨어는 설문 조사에서 각 참가자에게 제시되는 질문의 순서를 무작위화할 것이다.

definition: Relating to sensation or the physical senses.
exampleEn: The brain processes sensory information from the environment to create a coherent perception of the physical world.
exampleKr: 뇌는 물리적 세계에 대한 일관된 지각을 형성하기 위해 환경으로부터 오는 감각 정보를 처리한다.

definition: To keep or restrict someone or something within certain limits of space, scope, or time.
exampleEn: The researcher decided to confine the scope of the study to urban areas to ensure data consistency.
exampleKr: 연구자는 데이터 일관성을 보장하기 위해 연구 범위를 도시 지역으로 국한시키기로 결정했다.

definition: Relating to or situated on the edge or periphery of something; of secondary importance.
exampleEn: While the main issue is economic, there are several peripheral factors that also contribute to the social problem.
exampleKr: 주요 쟁점은 경제적이지만, 그 사회적 문제에 기여하는 몇 가지 지엽적인 요인들도 존재한다.

definition: A solid inorganic substance of natural occurrence.
exampleEn: The soil in this region is rich in essential mineral nutrients that promote the healthy growth of crops.
exampleKr: 이 지역의 토양은 작물의 건강한 성장을 촉진하는 필수 미네랄 영양소가 풍부하다.

definition: Happening or done in a natural, often sudden way, without any planning or outside cause.
exampleEn: The audience broke into spontaneous applause after the professor concluded his insightful lecture on ethics.
exampleKr: 청중은 교수의 윤리학에 관한 통찰력 있는 강의가 끝난 후 자발적인 박수를 보냈다.

definition: The quality of being trustworthy or of performing consistently well.
exampleEn: Researchers must ensure the reliability of their data by using standardized testing methods across all groups.
exampleKr: 연구자들은 모든 집단에 걸쳐 표준화된 테스트 방법을 사용함으로써 데이터의 신뢰도를 보장해야 한다.

definition: An organism or cell produced asexually from one ancestor to which they are genetically identical.
exampleEn: Scientists successfully created a genetic clone of the endangered species to preserve its unique biological traits.
exampleKr: 과학자들은 멸종 위기 종의 고유한 생물학적 특성을 보존하기 위해 유전적 복제 생물을 성공적으로 만들었다.

definition: To align or position something relative to the points of a compass or other specified positions.
exampleEn: New international students attend an induction program to help them orient themselves to the university campus.
exampleKr: 새로운 외국인 유학생들은 대학 캠퍼스에 적응하는 것을 돕기 위한 오리엔테이션 프로그램에 참석한다.

definition: Involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated in design.
exampleEn: The architect presented an elaborate design that incorporated sustainable materials and modern aesthetic elements.
exampleKr: 건축가는 지속 가능한 재료와 현대적인 미적 요소를 결합한 정교한 설계를 제시했다.

definition: Existing in name only; very small or far below the real value or cost.
exampleEn: The participants were charged a nominal fee to cover the administrative costs of the academic conference.
exampleKr: 참가자들에게는 학술 회의의 행정 비용을 충당하기 위해 명목상의 비용만이 부과되었다.

definition: To place, fit, or push something into something else.
exampleEn: The surgeon had to carefully insert a stent into the artery to improve the patient's blood flow.
exampleKr: 외과의는 환자의 혈류를 개선하기 위해 동맥에 스텐트를 조심스럽게 삽입해야 했다.

definition: The biological process by which new individual organisms are produced from their parents.
exampleEn: The study explores how environmental factors influence the rates of reproduction in various marine ecosystems.
exampleKr: 이 연구는 환경적 요인이 다양한 해양 생태계의 생식률에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 탐구한다.

definition: Power and influence over others; the state of being more important or powerful.

exampleKr: 경제 사학자들은 종종 19세기 동안 특정 제국들이 글로벌 무역로를 지배했던 것에 대해 논의한다.

definition: The action or process of distributing resources or shares for a particular purpose.

definition: Each of the pair of organs situated within the rib cage into which air is drawn.
exampleEn: Chronic exposure to air pollution can cause significant damage to the tissue of the human lung.
exampleKr: 대기 오염에 대한 만성적인 노출은 인간 폐 조직에 심각한 손상을 입힐 수 있다.

definition: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.
exampleEn: Implementing new technology in the workplace can make employees more productive and reduce operational costs.
exampleKr: 직장에 새로운 기술을 도입하는 것은 직원들을 더 생산적으로 만들고 운영 비용을 절감할 수 있다.

definition: The process of rotting or decomposing through the action of bacteria and fungi.
exampleEn: The organic matter undergoes a slow process of decay, returning essential nutrients back into the soil.
exampleKr: 유기물은 느린 부패 과정을 거치며 필수 영양분을 토양으로 다시 되돌려 보낸다.

definition: Aware of and responding to one's surroundings; awake.
exampleEn: The patient remained conscious throughout the minor surgical procedure and was able to follow instructions.
exampleKr: 환자는 소수술 내내 의식이 있는 상태를 유지했으며 지시 사항을 따를 수 있었다.

definition: The distance through an object, as distinct from width or height.
exampleEn: The thickness of the glacier has decreased significantly over the last decade due to rising global temperatures.
exampleKr: 지구 기온 상승으로 인해 지난 10년 동안 빙하의 두께가 크게 감소했다.

definition: To pass something from one person or place to another.
exampleEn: Satellites are used to transmit digital signals across vast distances, enabling global communication networks.
exampleKr: 인공위성은 광대한 거리에 걸쳐 디지털 신호를 전송하는 데 사용되어 글로벌 통신망을 가능하게 한다.

definition: To form or devise a plan or idea in the mind.
exampleEn: It is difficult to conceive of a society where technology does not play a central role in daily life.
exampleKr: 기술이 일상생활에서 중심적인 역할을 하지 않는 사회를 상상하기란 어렵다.

definition: A person's child or children; an animal's young.
exampleEn: In many species, parents invest significant energy into ensuring the survival and growth of their offspring.
exampleKr: 많은 종에서 부모는 자손의 생존과 성장을 보장하기 위해 상당한 에너지를 투자한다.

definition: To have qualities or features, especially those of appearance, in common with someone or something else.
exampleEn: The synthetic material was engineered to closely resemble the properties of natural spider silk.
exampleKr: 그 합성 물질은 천연 거미줄의 특성과 매우 유사하도록 공학적으로 설계되었다.

definition: The movement of blood through the vessels of the body that is induced by the pumping action of the heart.
exampleEn: Regular physical exercise is essential for maintaining healthy blood circulation and cardiovascular health.
exampleKr: 규칙적인 신체 운동은 건강한 혈액 순환과 심혈관 건강을 유지하는 데 필수적이다.

definition: In a way that is true, factual, or appropriate; accurately.
exampleEn: To obtain valid results, students must ensure that they calibrate the laboratory equipment correctly before use.
exampleKr: 유효한 결과를 얻으려면 학생들은 사용 전에 실험 장비를 정확하게 보정해야 한다.

definition: The fact of being required or indispensable.
exampleEn: Access to clean drinking water is a basic human necessity that remains unavailable in many parts of the world.
exampleKr: 깨끗한 식수에 대한 접근은 기본적인 인간의 필수 요건이지만 세계의 많은 지역에서 여전히 이용 불가능하다.

definition: A figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.
exampleEn: The poet used the metaphor of a stormy sea to represent the internal conflict of the protagonist.
exampleKr: 시인은 주인공의 내적 갈등을 표현하기 위해 폭풍우 치는 바다라는 은유를 사용했다.

definition: An area of indefinite extent, typically a large one; or a system of organs.
exampleEn: The digestive tract is a complex series of organs responsible for breaking down food and absorbing nutrients.
exampleKr: 소화관은 음식물을 분해하고 영양분을 흡수하는 역할을 담당하는 일련의 복잡한 기관들이다.

definition: A large lobed glandular organ in the abdomen of vertebrates, involved in many metabolic processes.
exampleEn: The liver plays a crucial role in detoxifying harmful substances and producing bile for digestion.
exampleKr: 간은 유해 물질을 해독하고 소화를 위한 담즙을 생성하는 데 중요한 역할을 한다.

definition: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.
exampleEn: The assessment of art is often subjective, as different individuals may perceive the same work differently.
exampleKr: 예술에 대한 평가는 종종 주관적인데, 서로 다른 개인들이 같은 작품을 다르게 인식할 수 있기 때문이다.

definition: To gather together or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.
exampleEn: Over time, dust and debris can accumulate in the ventilation system, reducing its overall efficiency.
exampleKr: 시간이 지나면서 먼지와 파편이 환기 시스템에 축적되어 전체적인 효율성을 떨어뜨릴 수 있다.

definition: The dismissing or refusing of a proposal, idea, or person.
exampleEn: The journal's rejection of the manuscript was based on the lack of original contribution to the field.
exampleKr: 학술지의 원고 거절은 해당 분야에 대한 독창적인 기여가 부족하다는 점에 근거했다.

definition: To make as large or great as possible.
exampleEn: Corporations often seek to maximize their profits by reducing waste and increasing production efficiency.
exampleKr: 기업들은 종종 낭비를 줄이고 생산 효율을 높임으로써 이윤을 극대화하려고 노력한다.

definition: The action or process of replacing someone or something with another.
exampleEn: The replacement of outdated machinery with automated systems led to a significant increase in factory output.
exampleKr: 구식 기계를 자동화 시스템으로 교체한 결과 공장 생산량이 크게 증가했다.

definition: In the middle of or included in a group of people or things.
exampleEn: The decision was made after a long period of discussion amongst the members of the committee.
exampleKr: 그 결정은 위원회 위원들 사이의 긴 토론 끝에 내려졌다.

definition: A circumstance that complicates something; a secondary disease or condition aggravating an already existing one.
exampleEn: The patient experienced a minor complication during recovery, but it was quickly resolved by the medical team.
exampleKr: 환자는 회복 중에 가벼운 합병증을 겪었으나 의료진에 의해 신속하게 해결되었다.

definition: A device for controlling the passage of fluid or air through a pipe or duct.
exampleEn: The heart valve ensures that blood flows in only one direction through the cardiac chambers.
exampleKr: 심장 판막은 혈액이 심장 내실을 통해 한 방향으로만 흐르도록 보장한다.

definition: Denoting more than one in number.
exampleEn: Modern societies are often plural, consisting of various ethnic, religious, and cultural groups living together.
exampleKr: 현대 사회는 종종 다원적인데, 다양한 민족, 종교, 문화 집단이 함께 어우러져 살아가기 때문이다.

definition: The process by which one thing absorbs or is absorbed by another.
exampleEn: The absorption of carbon dioxide by the oceans helps to mitigate the effects of global warming.
exampleKr: 해양에 의한 이산화탄소 흡수는 지구 온난화의 영향을 완화하는 데 도움을 준다.

definition: Relating to money or currency.
exampleEn: The central bank adjusted the monetary policy to control inflation and stabilize the national economy.
exampleKr: 중앙은행은 인플레이션을 조절하고 국가 경제를 안정시키기 위해 통화 정책을 조정했다.

definition: Relating to heat.
exampleEn: Thermal energy can be harnessed from the earth's interior to provide a sustainable source of electricity.
exampleKr: 지구 내부에서 열에너지를 추출하여 지속 가능한 전력원을 제공할 수 있다.

definition: In the same way; also.
exampleEn: The first experiment showed positive results, and the subsequent trials conducted in other labs performed likewise.
exampleKr: 첫 번째 실험은 긍정적인 결과를 보여주었으며, 다른 실험실에서 수행된 후속 시험들도 마찬가지였다.

definition: The ability or willingness to tolerate something, in particular the existence of opinions or behavior that one does not necessarily agree with.
exampleEn: Religious tolerance is a fundamental principle in maintaining peace within a diverse and multicultural society.
exampleKr: 종교적 관용은 다양하고 다문화적인 사회 내에서 평화를 유지하는 데 있어 근본적인 원칙이다.

definition: Having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently.
exampleEn: The candidate was able to articulate her vision for the company's future clearly during the interview.
exampleKr: 그 후보자는 면접 동안 회사의 미래에 대한 자신의 비전을 분명하게 표현할 수 있었다.

definition: A person who provides something, such as money, blood, or an organ, to be used by others.
exampleEn: The hospital is searching for a compatible bone marrow donor to save the young patient's life.
exampleKr: 병원은 어린 환자의 생명을 구하기 위해 적합한 골수 기증자를 찾고 있다.

definition: The action or process of flowing or flowing out; continuous change.
exampleEn: The political situation in the region is in a state of constant flux, making predictions difficult.
exampleKr: 그 지역의 정치 상황은 끊임없는 변화의 상태에 있어 예측을 어렵게 만든다.

definition: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.
exampleEn: Social mobility allows individuals to improve their economic status through education and hard work.
exampleKr: 사회적 유동성은 개인이 교육과 노력을 통해 자신의 경제적 지위를 향상시킬 수 있게 해준다.

definition: The action of manipulating something in a clever or unscrupulous way.
exampleEn: Critics argued that the statistical manipulation of the data led to misleading conclusions in the report.
exampleKr: 비평가들은 데이터에 대한 통계적 조작이 보고서에서 오해의 소지가 있는 결론을 초래했다고 주장했다.

definition: To raise or lift something up to a higher position.
exampleEn: The new marketing strategy was designed to elevate the brand's image and attract high-end consumers.
exampleKr: 새로운 마케팅 전략은 브랜드 이미지를 높이고 고소득층 소비자들을 끌어들이기 위해 설계되었다.

definition: Identification with one's own nation and support for its interests, especially to the exclusion or detriment of the interests of other nations.
exampleEn: In the early twentieth century, rising nationalism contributed to the outbreak of several major global conflicts.
exampleKr: 20세기 초, 고조된 민족주의는 몇몇 주요 글로벌 갈등의 발발에 기여했다.

definition: A comparison between two things, typically for the purpose of explanation or clarification.
exampleEn: The teacher used the analogy of a computer's hard drive to explain how human memory functions.
exampleKr: 교사는 인간의 기억이 어떻게 작동하는지 설명하기 위해 컴퓨터 하드 드라이브라는 비유를 사용했다.

definition: Preventing success or development; harmful; unfavorable.
exampleEn: The medication was withdrawn from the market after patients reported experiencing severe adverse side effects.
exampleKr: 환자들이 심각한 부정적인 부작용을 겪었다고 보고한 후 그 약물은 시장에서 회수되었다.

definition: Seeming reasonable or probable.

exampleKr: 형사는 범행 당시 용의자의 행방에 대해 타당해 보이는 설명을 찾으려 노력했다.

definition: A chemical element that is a gas with no color or smell, forming about 78 percent of the earth's atmosphere.
exampleEn: Nitrogen is an essential nutrient for plant growth and is a key component of many fertilizers.
exampleKr: 질소는 식물 성장에 필수적인 영양소이며 많은 비료의 핵심 성분이다.

definition: The blood vessels that carry blood back toward the heart.
exampleEn: The surgeon carefully avoided the major vein during the delicate procedure on the patient's arm.
exampleKr: 외과 의사는 환자의 팔에 대한 정밀한 수술을 진행하는 동안 주요 정맥을 조심스럽게 피했다.

definition: A state of prolonged public dispute or debate over a matter of opinion.
exampleEn: The new government policy regarding environmental regulations sparked intense controversy among local business owners.
exampleKr: 환경 규제에 관한 정부의 새로운 정책은 지역 사업주들 사이에서 격렬한 논란을 불러일으켰다.

definition: A cereal grain that is a worldwide staple food used for flour.
exampleEn: The country’s agricultural output relies heavily on the export of high-quality wheat to international markets.
exampleKr: 그 나라의 농업 생산량은 고품질 밀의 국제 시장 수출에 크게 의존하고 있다.

definition: To write something again in order to improve it or change it.
exampleEn: The student was asked to rewrite her thesis statement to more clearly reflect her argument.
exampleKr: 그 학생은 자신의 논지를 더 명확하게 반영하기 위해 논문 주제문을 다시 쓰라는 요청을 받았다.

definition: A book giving instructions or information, or something done by hand.
exampleEn: Before operating the heavy machinery, all employees must thoroughly read the safety manual provided.
exampleKr: 중장비를 조작하기 전에 모든 직원은 제공된 안전 설명서를 철저히 읽어야 한다.

definition: Relating to the identification of long-term or overall aims and interests.
exampleEn: The company made a strategic decision to expand its operations into the emerging Southeast Asian market.
exampleKr: 그 회사는 신흥 동남아시아 시장으로 사업을 확장하기 위해 전략적인 결정을 내렸다.

definition: A poor farmer of low social status who owns or rents a small piece of land.
exampleEn: In medieval Europe, the majority of the population consisted of peasants working on feudal estates.
exampleKr: 중세 유럽에서 인구의 대다수는 봉건 영지에서 일하는 소작농들로 구성되어 있었다.

definition: To take in or soak up a substance or information.
exampleEn: Plants use their roots to absorb water and essential nutrients from the surrounding soil.
exampleKr: 식물은 주변 토양으로부터 물과 필수 영양분을 흡수하기 위해 뿌리를 사용한다.

definition: A rough or unfinished drawing or painting, often made to assist in making a more finished picture.
exampleEn: The architect presented a quick sketch of the proposed building to the board of directors.
exampleKr: 건축가는 이사회에 제안된 건물의 빠른 스케치를 제시했다.

definition: The action of showing something to be right or reasonable.
exampleEn: The researcher provided a strong justification for the use of qualitative methods in his study.
exampleKr: 연구자는 자신의 연구에서 질적 연구 방법을 사용하는 것에 대한 강력한 정당성을 제시했다.

definition: The duration of a person's life or the functional period of an object.
exampleEn: Many species of birds migrate thousands of miles multiple times throughout their entire lifetime.
exampleKr: 많은 종류의 새들이 평생 동안 수천 마일을 여러 번 이동한다.

definition: Something having two parts or components, often used in computing.
exampleEn: Computers process all information using a binary system consisting of only zeros and ones.
exampleKr: 컴퓨터는 0과 1로만 구성된 이진법 체계를 사용하여 모든 정보를 처리한다.

definition: Clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful.
exampleEn: The scientists have not yet reached a definite conclusion regarding the cause of the phenomenon.
exampleKr: 과학자들은 그 현상의 원인에 대해 아직 확실한 결론에 도달하지 못했다.

definition: An outline, especially one representing or bounding the shape or form of something.
exampleEn: The topographic map uses contour lines to represent the elevation and shape of the terrain.
exampleKr: 지형도는 지형의 고도와 형태를 나타내기 위해 등고선을 사용한다.

definition: The carrying out or putting into effect of a plan, order, or course of action.
exampleEn: Success depends not only on a good strategy but also on its effective execution by the team.
exampleKr: 성공은 좋은 전략뿐만 아니라 팀에 의한 효과적인 실행에 달려 있다.

definition: A strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound.
exampleEn: The poet used a specific rhythm and rhyme scheme to enhance the emotional impact of the verse.
exampleKr: 시인은 시구의 정서적 효과를 높이기 위해 특정한 리듬과 압운 체계를 사용했다.

definition: Being or happening at the end of a process; final.
exampleEn: The ultimate goal of the research project is to find a sustainable cure for the disease.
exampleKr: 그 연구 프로젝트의 궁극적인 목표는 그 질병에 대한 지속 가능한 치료법을 찾는 것이다.

definition: A resource that lists the words of a language and gives their meaning.
exampleEn: Students are encouraged to use a dictionary to look up unfamiliar academic terms during their studies.
exampleKr: 학생들은 학습 중에 생소한 학술 용어를 찾아보기 위해 사전을 사용하도록 권장된다.

definition: A body of fundamental principles according to which a state or organization is governed.
exampleEn: The democratic nation's constitution guarantees the fundamental rights and freedoms of all its citizens.
exampleKr: 그 민주 국가의 헌법은 모든 시민의 기본권과 자유를 보장한다.

definition: The rate of change of velocity per unit of time.
exampleEn: The rapid acceleration of technological advancement has significantly transformed the way we communicate globally.
exampleKr: 기술 발전의 급격한 가속화는 우리가 전 세계적으로 소통하는 방식을 크게 변화시켰다.

definition: To lessen the effectiveness, power, or ability of someone or something.
exampleEn: Frequent absences from class can seriously undermine a student's ability to succeed in the course.
exampleKr: 잦은 수업 결석은 해당 과목에서 성공하고자 하는 학생의 능력을 심각하게 약화시킬 수 있다.

definition: An unfavorable circumstance or condition that reduces the chances of success.
exampleEn: Living in a remote area can be a major disadvantage when seeking specialized medical treatment.
exampleKr: 외딴 지역에 사는 것은 전문적인 의료 치료를 받을 때 큰 불이익이 될 수 있다.

definition: A traditional story or a widely held but false belief or idea.
exampleEn: The belief that humans only use ten percent of their brains is a common scientific myth.
exampleKr: 인간이 뇌의 10퍼센트만 사용한다는 믿음은 흔한 과학적 근거 없는 믿음이다.

definition: A single thin length of something such as thread or fiber.
exampleEn: DNA is composed of two long strands that wrap around each other in a double helix.
exampleKr: DNA는 이중 나선 구조로 서로를 감싸고 있는 두 개의 긴 가닥으로 구성되어 있다.

definition: To make or become united, uniform, or whole.
exampleEn: The leader sought to unify the different factions of the party before the upcoming national election.
exampleKr: 그 지도자는 다가오는 총선을 앞두고 당내의 서로 다른 파벌들을 통합하고자 노력했다.

definition: In a way that happens by chance rather than according to a plan.
exampleEn: Participants in the clinical trial were randomly assigned to either the control or experimental group.
